title: Campaign board buttons (close X, All, ?, Got it, campaign rows, drill row, action rows) make no tap sound
repro: Menu > Map > Campaign map: tap a campaign row, then '◀ All', '?', 'Got it', '✕'. Silent (CampaignScreen._btn connects only the callback; game_menu/title _button play ui_tap). Only node selection (pickup) and some acts have sounds.
fix: In CampaignScreen._btn connect a Music.sfx('ui_tap','pickup') before cb (skip it for callbacks that already play their own jingle, or let the jingle override via the 70 ms rule being per-name); play 'menu_close' in close().

title: Locked actions on the campaign board fail silently (muster refused, drill locked, visiting refusals)
repro: Campaign board: tap Muster when CampaignGate.muster returns '' (returns with no feedback at all); tap Training drill before chapter 2 (_flash_list text, no sound); while visiting a friend tap Muster/Attack (_flash_msg only).
fix: Play Music.sfx('nope','thud') on every refusal path in _muster (line=='' and Net.visiting), _start_drill (why!=''), _attack (visiting); for line=='' also flash CampaignGate.lock(cid) so the tap isn't dead.

title: Marching the army plays sfx('step') which does not exist, so it falls back to 'pickup' (same blip as selecting a node)
repro: Campaign board: select an adjacent held node, tap March. campaign_screen.gd:471 sfx('step','pickup'); audio/sfx has no step.* (only step_<ground>). Player hears the node-select pickup again.
fix: Use a march cue: 'march' if added, else sfx('step_gravel') twice or 'horn' for the gangster crew; or add a short drum/boots cue j_march via tools/ace_kits.py / cc0_import.
audio_needed: optional: short marching boots/drum roll cue (march, gang variant could be car_start)

title: Camp/cache settle always plays a coin clink, even for Rest and Forage; Crystal Kin settle plays the battle-won jingle
repro: Board: march onto a camp, choose Rest ('Fires, songs and a good night's sleep') -> coin sound (campaign_screen.gd:489). Crystal Kin nest choice -> j_battle_won (line 483), though no battle happened.
fix: Map choice -> cue: take='chest_open', share='coin', rest='campfire'/'yawn' or 'j_confirm', forage='harvest'; Kin settle -> 'sparkle'/'j_secret' style magical cue (or a dedicated j_kin).

title: Gangster Gun Turret fires with the robot 'zap' sound; turrets take hits silently and run out/expire silently
repro: Gangster campaign battle: build a Gun Turret at a held point. Each shot plays sfx('zap') (bot.gd:59, shared with Cyber bots) though it is drawn and named a gun; foes hitting it (BattleTurret.take_damage) make no sound; after life 45 s it poofs with no sound (bot.gd:45-47, same for player-dropped bots).
fix: Give Bot a overridable shot_sfx() (BattleTurret: 'shot_rifle' gangsters, 'laser'/'sparkle' penguin pylon); BattleTurret.take_damage: sfx('hit','thud') throttled (penguin 'glass' light tap); bot.gd life<=0: sfx('power_off','pop').

title: Battle point refusals and neutral flips are silent: USE on an enemy/neutral banner, and an ally point knocked to neutral (no spawner)
repro: Campaign battle: press USE on a banner you don't hold -> toast 'Take X first...' only (battle.gd interact, no sfx). Let foes stand on a held point without a spawner: owner goes ally->neutral silently (only the spawner case plays power_off; enemy capture plays alert later).
fix: interact(): sfx('nope','thud') with the toast. _capture: when was=='ally' and owner becomes 'neutral' play sfx('alert','thud') + toast '%s is contested' (once per point per 5 s).

title: Every rally order (guard / follow me / send to point) plays the generic 'pickup' blip
repro: Battle: tap RALLY repeatedly or pick from the list (battle.gd _cycle_rally/_pick_rally: sfx('pickup')). Same sound as picking up a berry; an order to the troops reads as nothing.
fix: Per mode: follow me -> 'whistle' (or 'horn' at low volume), guard -> 'block'/'j_confirm', send -> 'horn'; gangster arc could use 'whistle' for all. Add a short whistle cue if none exists.

title: The escort convoy has no movement sound and no warning when it is badly hurt or left behind
repro: Escort battle: the cart/sled rolls the whole route in silence (only car_start/j_confirm once, alert when blocked, hit/horn). Dropping under 1/3 hp only changes the bar colour; walking away (roll -> wait) is silent, so on a phone with the convoy off-screen you can't tell it stopped or is dying.
fix: While state=='roll' play a soft loop/tick every ~0.6 s via _sfx: 'cart_roll'/'step_gravel' (gang 'car_idle'), penguins 'sled_bells' quiet; on first drop below 1/3 hp play 'alert' + hud.toast('The convoy is badly hurt!'); on roll->wait play a short 'nope'/'horn' honk once (throttled 6 s).
audio_needed: optional: cart wheel / sled runner loop (short, loopable)

title: Mega travel keeper: accepting the hook quest, the route opening and the locked/wrong-arc answers are silent
repro: Talk to a mega travel point: locked -> keeper line + hint toast, no sound; wrong arc -> toast only; 'I'll do it' -> 'New quest: ...' toast with no cue (game_map.gd:889's quest offers play quest_done); finishing it opens a new region and a 'New map tab' toast with no unlock sound before the travel menu.
fix: mega_travel.gd gate(): locked/wrong_arc -> sfx('nope','thud'); quest accepted -> sfx('j_confirm','pickup'); after setting mega_<id>_open (before _travel_menu) -> sfx('unlock','j_region').

title: Walking into a campaign-held region gives no bump/lock sound before the gate words
repro: Walk into an exit to a region still held by a campaign: GameMap.go_to returns via Campaign.blocks, player is stopped and Campaign.offer shows the sense lines with no sound (talk blips only once text shows, after m.later).
fix: Campaign.blocks(): when it starts an offer (the 1.5 s throttle branch) play Music.sfx('alert' if board else 'nope','thud') so the stop reads as a held border.

title: Hidden pocket sounds are mismatched or missing: rock crack and stone sun door play the wooden 'crate_break', vines play a footstep, sealed door and repeat secret-way trips are silent
repro: Mega area: break a crack with the pickaxe -> crate_break (wood splinter) instead of rock_break; open the sun door ('grinds open') -> crate_break; part a vine nook -> step_grass; USE the sealed sun door before its flag -> 'Sealed.' with no sound; take a found secret way a second time -> only poof fx, silent teleport (first trip plays j_secret).
fix: hidden_area.gd interact(): crack -> sfx('rock_break','thud'); door -> sfx('bowl_rumble' or a new 'stone_grind','door'); vine -> sfx('step_leaves','step_grass'); sealed -> sfx('nope','thud'); secret_way every trip -> sfx('teleport' for portals / 'step_stone' x2 for stairs/tunnels) before the poof.

title: Winning the seasonal Rec Cup (+100 tickets) has no fanfare: the 'Rec Cup won!' note toasts in silence
repro: Once the trophy hall is open, beat the season's cup score in its game. RecReno.cup_score -> GameState.notify('Rec Cup won! ...'); GameMap._process plays a sound for notes only if they contain 'letter'/'level'/'heart'/'built', so the cup toast is silent (and arrives after the game screen closes, after its own end sound).
fix: In RecReno.cup_score play Music.sfx('j_victory','quest_done') directly (or add a 'cup' keyword branch to the notes loop in game_map.gd: 'rec cup' -> j_victory + fx levelup). Optionally a crowd cheer ('cheer') on the rec floor.

title: Tapping a taped-off/covered renovation corner (cabinet, skee, jukebox, prize tier) gives a toast with no sound
repro: Rec Center during a renovation: USE a cabinet marked 'A: under renovation' or 'covered (coming soon)'. rec_center.gd:648-651 toasts RecReno.blocked text and returns, silent.
fix: Add Music.sfx('nope','thud') next to that toast (and in prize-tier lock paths that show Tickets.lock_text). A hammer tap ('hammer') while working() reads as builders at work.

title: Multi-day community farm builds are silent: no hammering/sawing at the build site while the crew works
repro: Fill a 'build' stage (shed/well/greenhouse) and visit the community farm on the build days: sawhorse/frame props (community_farm.gd:360-426) show work in progress but Ambience only adds crowd/campfire for this map (ambience.gd:194-199); no construction sound at all, so 'drop by and watch it go up' has nothing to hear.
fix: ambience.gd: when id=='community_farm' and Commons.pending()>=0 and ph=='day', add a spot cue list ['hammer','saw'] at -18 dB every 4-9 s positioned at the build site (or play from community_farm.gd _process near the sawhorse within 120 px). Add a 'saw' cue via cc0_import if missing.
audio_needed: optional: hand saw / hammering spot sounds (CC0)

title: Community farm board refusals are silent (nothing to give, ask not met, visiting host)
repro: Board > 'Give what I carry' with none of the needs -> toast 'You carry nothing this stage still needs.'; 'Give for the ask' short -> 'Not enough yet: ...'; as a co-op guest -> host toast. All in Commons.open_board with no sfx, while success plays pickup/quest_done.
fix: Add Music.sfx('nope','thud') next to each of those three toasts in open_board (and in _buy/_sell refusals if any lack it).

title: Seasonal ask reward adds crystals straight to run.crystals, bypassing GameState.add_money (earned_total/earned_by, cash sound swap)
repro: commons.gd give_ask(): GameState.run['crystals'] += rw.crystals. CLAUDE.md: money in goes through GameState.add_money(n, source).
fix: Replace with GameState.add_money(int(rw['crystals']), 'commons'); then play sfx('cash','coin') with the quest_done jingle (or let quest_done stand).

title: Indoors, the rain-on-roof bed follows the Valley calendar, not the region's own weather (mega/region interiors)
repro: ambience.gd ~line 202: house/interior adds rain_roof when GameState.is_wet() (calendar weather_today). Outdoors the same function uses m.sky.weather (region weather: desert 'sun', wind_storm_shelf 'storm'). On a Valley rain day, entering a building from a sunny mega hub (Sunscorch) plays rain on the roof; on a dry day inside a building off the Storm Shelf there is none.
fix: For interiors use the weather of the map you came from: store the outdoor map's sky weather when entering (e.g. GameState.run['flags']['last_out_weather'] set in GameMap.go_to when scene=='interior', or the interior's 'back' scene -> regions.json weather) and test that instead of is_wet().

title: Helper spawns, turret boots and helper/turret deaths play at full volume from anywhere on the field (no distance gate), and helper spawns use the craft_done jingle
repro: Battle with 3-4 spawner points: every spawn at any point (battle.gd _tick ~line 428, 50% of spawns) plays craft_done, every turret rebuild plays power_up (BattleTurret.make_at), every helper/turret death power_off/glass (HelperUnit.take_damage, BattleTurret.take_damage) with no distance check, while HelperUnit._sfx gates attacks to 200 px. Off-screen points keep chiming a 'something crafted' jingle mid-fight.
fix: Route these through a shared distance gate (as HelperUnit._sfx/CampaignConvoy._sfx do: < 200-260 px from the player, else skip or play at -8 dB). Use a short neutral 'pop'/'teleport' for a helper stepping out instead of craft_done; keep craft_done only for the player's own Build choice. Team members (team_id) falling back can stay global (they're yours).

title: Finishing the last drill step stacks two jingles (quest_done + j_battle_won in the same frame)
repro: Training: First Muster, complete step 6: battle_drill.gd:121 plays quest_done, then b._end(true) -> _end_drill plays j_battle_won immediately; both ring over each other.
fix: In BattleDrill._process skip the quest_done when step == STEPS.size()-1 (the win jingle covers it).

title: More C3-C5 earnings still bypass GameState.add_money: community farm stage reward and market stand pay, hidden/secret chest gold
repro: commons.gd:477 (finish_stage crystals), :837 (_sell market pay), secrets.gd secret_chest '#gold' all do run['crystals'] += n directly (STATUS C4 P1 says community farm goes through add_money). earned_total/earned_by miss them; same pattern elsewhere: companion.gd:330, marked.gd:75, perks.gd:80, project.gd:323, racket.gd:80 (out of my scope, listed for the fixer).
fix: Replace each with GameState.add_money(n, '<source>') ('commons', 'market', 'secret'); combine with the commons.gd:589 finding above.

title: Re-opening an already looted secret/hidden chest is silent
repro: USE a secret_chest you already emptied: toast 'Empty. You already found what was in it.' with no sound (secrets.gd ~line 218).
fix: Add Music.sfx('chest_open','thud') (a hollow lid creak) with the toast.

title: Battle briefing buttons (Fight / Don't show again / Not now) and the Map tab's region tab row are silent
repro: Start a campaign fight or the drill: the BattleBrief card opens with 'page' but tapping Fight (or A), 'don't show again' or Not now (or B) plays nothing (battle_brief.gd _close/_not_now). Menu > Map: tapping a region tab (Valley / Gloamwood / ... MegaMap.tab_row Buttons) is silent while the menu's own tabs play 'tab'.
fix: BattleBrief._close: sfx('j_confirm','ui_tap') when leaving by Fight; _not_now: sfx('menu_close','ui_tap'). MegaMap.tab_row pressed: Music.sfx('tab','ui_tap') (instance via b.get_tree()).

title: Winter footsteps are 'snow' on every outdoor cell: swimming, wooden bridges/docks and cleared paths/paving all crunch; wet days never splash on the new puddles
repro: footsteps.gd word(): the look_se()=='winter' and has_sky check (line ~67) returns 'snow' before the swimming/water check and before step_word/ground_word, so in winter a swim, a pier (DockLayer wood), a bridge and the town plaza (C5 keeps drifts off paths and paving, WorldGen.on_path) all play step_snow. On rain/storm days WorldGen._puddle places puddles but steps stay dry grass/dirt.
fix: Reorder: swimming/water first; then step_word/ground_word for wood/stone/gravel path words (keep them in winter, maybe 'snow' only for grass/dirt/leaves bases); then winter -> snow for the remaining natural ground. On GameState.is_wet() (or region sky rain) map grass/dirt -> 'mud' (or a 'puddle' cell set from WorldGen._puddle -> 'water').

title: 'They're massing on <point>!' (enemy wave targets one of your points) is a silent toast
repro: Campaign battle holding several points: when the enemy picks a new target among your points (battle.gd ~line 600) only a toast shows. On a phone mid-fight the toast is easy to miss; it's the one warning that tells you where to defend. Same for 'Your team pushes on' (720), '<team> fights beside you' (691), 'The fight picks up where you left it' (1134).
fix: battle.gd: sfx('alert','horn') with the massing toast (throttled, e.g. 8 s); 'fights beside you' -> sfx('j_confirm','pop'); resume -> sfx('j_battle_start','alert') at low weight or 'horn'.

title: Scrap dealer payout on the community farm lot plays no coin/cash sound
repro: Clear a scrap junk pile on the community farm lot: add_money + toast 'The scrap dealer pays ◆N' (community_farm.gd ~860), no sound beyond the tool hit; Commons._sell/_buy use 'cash'.
fix: Add Music.instance(get_tree()).sfx('cash','coin') next to the toast (Money.sfx_name swaps coin->cash_pickup in the gangster arc anyway).

title: Rec Center and community farm 'can't do that' toasts are silent across the board
repro: rec_center.gd: why_closed (494, 646, 750), 'Not enough crystals for a game' (726, 756), 'Not enough crystals.' (976), 'Game abandoned. No tickets.' (793), rec-hours refusal (206); commons.gd: visiting host (644, 662, 766), 'You carry no produce to give/sell' (770, 822), empty share crate (851), well 'had your fill' (888). None plays a sound while their success paths do.
fix: Add Music.sfx('nope','thud') beside each refusal toast (one helper e.g. RecCenter._no(m, text) / Commons._no(m, text) that toasts + plays nope). Welcome gift / festival sponsor ticket toasts (631, 103) -> sfx('tickets' or 'coin').

title: Mega ride sounds are uneven: Sunscorch 'horse' is ~7 LU quieter than the others, Ironline train quieter too, and the Gloamwood fairy-ring ride is a 0.3 s 'sparkle'
repro: Measured with ffmpeg ebur128: horse.ogg -25.2 LUFS (2.0 s), train_depart -21.8 LUFS, vs car_start -18.1, airship_whoosh -18.6, sled_bells -19.6, j_region -13.9 (which follows on arrival). Gloamwood/windward-fallback rides use sparkle (0.32 s blip, also used for every small shimmer). The Sunscorch caravan ride is barely audible over the area song and the region banner jingle then jumps 11 LU louder.
fix: Level horse/train_depart to about -18 LUFS (sfx_soften.py --only horse,train_depart --force, or re-import), and give the fairy ring its own 1.5-2.5 s 'fairy_ring' whoosh-chime (ACE kit / CC0) in MegaTravel.TRAVEL_SFX['gloamwood']. Optionally move TRAVEL_SFX into tools/mega_regions_new.py as sfx_go/sfx_back so mega_travel.json's stale 'sfx':'door' entries stop disagreeing.
audio_needed: fairy ring travel cue (1.5-2.5 s magical whoosh); re-levelled horse + train_depart

area: pet voice (seen in passing) + Crystal Kin
title: A cat pet barks: every pet sound is 'bark' although meow.ogg (3 takes) exists and is never played; the Kin nest's 'Meow Pow Wow' choice is silent of meows too; hidden pocket hint says 'Your pup' for a cat
repro: New game, character look with a cat pet (title.gd names it 'Kitty'; pet.gd:125 knows who=='cat'). Pet commands (touch_controls.gd:236), bites (pet.gd:507) and the mine pup (pup_mine.gd:105) all sfx('bark'); audio/sfx/meow*.ogg is unused (grep finds no sfx('meow')). hidden_area.gd:404 toasts 'Your pup sniffs at something nearby...' silently, for cats too. Campaign board _kin('meow') plays j_battle_won.
fix: Add Pet.voice() -> 'meow' if look pet begins with 'cat' else 'bark' and use it at all three call sites; hidden_area.gd:404 -> '%s sniffs at something nearby...' % Pet.name_of() + sfx(Pet.voice()); campaign_screen _kin: choice=='meow' -> sfx('meow') then the settle cue.

title: Dust/sandstorm and fog weather have no sound of their own (only the region's soft wind or nothing)
repro: desert_dune_sea (weather 'dust', ov_dust streaks) gets only the Sunscorch wind_soft at -12 dB; 'sandstorm' (Scenery overlay) is never named in Ambience; fog days (calendar or marsh/wastes/moonpool) add nothing. Rain/storm/snow/blizzard/wind each have a bed.
fix: ambience.gd beds(): w in ['dust','sandstorm'] -> wind_strong at -10 (sandstorm -6) and drop birds; w=='fog' -> lower birds by 6 dB and (sea/lake maps) an occasional distant 'spot_foghorn' if added; keep music duck as for storms when sandstorm.

title: Gangster convoy is drawn as a covered horse cart but sets off with a car engine ('car_start') and arrives with a car horn
repro: Gangster escort battle: CampaignConvoy._draw uses props/cart_covered (penguins get veh_crystal_sled_side), while _process plays car_start on roll and horn on arrival. Sound and picture disagree. props/veh_getaway_car_side exists.
fix: Either draw the gangster convoy with props/veh_getaway_car_side (keeps car_start/horn, matches the arc) or keep the cart and use a cart cue (wood creak / 'horse'). Drawing the getaway car is the cheaper fix.

title: Storms are silent indoors: no muffled thunder with the rain-on-roof bed
repro: Storm day, go into the house: rain_roof plays (ambience.gd ~202) but Ambience.thunder() is only triggered by Scenery's lightning flash on outdoor maps, so a storm indoors has no thunder at all.
fix: In Ambience._process, when inside house/interior on a storm day, call thunder() every 8-20 s with _spot('thunder', -12) (lower, centred).

title: Walking off a campaign battlefield mid-fight retreats with no sound, no toast and no confirm (morale -15, supply cut to a third)
repro: Campaign fight: walk into a field exit before the fight ends. Battle._exit_tree -> Campaign.retreat(supply): retreats+1, morale -15, supply/3, all silent; the player only finds out later on the board. No 'Retreat?' prompt on bf_ exits (grep finds none).
fix: Guard bf_ exits while a campaign fight runs: GameMap.check_exits (or Battle hooking map.check_exits) asks 'Fall back? Morale -15, supply lost' with a 'Keep fighting' way out; on confirm play sfx('j_battle_lost','thud') and toast the cost. If no prompt is wanted, at least set a flag in retreat() that the next map's Hud toasts with sfx('nope').

title: Mustering reuses j_battle_start, so the same jingle plays at muster and again at the first fight; no distinct 'army assembled' moment
repro: Campaign board: Muster -> j_battle_start (campaign_screen.gd:377); Attack the first node -> Battle.start plays j_battle_start again (battle.gd:66) plus the BattleBrief 'page'.
fix: Use a muster cue: 'horn' + 'j_confirm' (or a new short war-drum roll 'j_muster', gang variant: car doors + horn) in _muster; keep j_battle_start for fights.
audio_needed: optional: j_muster (2 s drum roll / rally horn, both arcs)

title: Gangster escort battles have no _gang song (battle_escort_gang missing) while battle and siege do; campaign board music is the same for both arcs
repro: area_track() on bf_ with mode escort/supply -> battle_escort, adds _gang only if Music.has_track('battle_escort_gang'); audio/music has battle_gang and battle_siege_gang but no battle_escort_gang, so gangster convoys (data vehicle 'truck', Campaign.battle_data) play the plain escort song. CampaignScreen always plays 'campaign_map' (no campaign_map_gang).
fix: Render battle_escort_gang (and optionally campaign_map_gang) via ACE (tools/ace_batch.py, music kind) in the gritty funk/noir style of battle_gang; CampaignScreen._ready: play 'campaign_map_gang' when not penguins and Music.has_track it. Also note: CampaignConvoy ignores d['vehicle'] ('truck') and draws a cart (see the convoy polish item).
audio_needed: battle_escort_gang loop (gangster escort/convoy fight), optional campaign_map_gang

title: Rec renovations make no work sound: taped-off corners are silent while 'under renovation' for days
repro: During a RecReno phase (RecReno.working(id)), the rec rooms play their normal beds/spots (RecAudio.BEDS/SPOTS); nothing in rec_audio.gd reads RecReno, so the renovation is visual-only.
fix: RecAudio spots: when any RecReno.working(id) for this room, add 'hammer' (and a 'saw'/'drill' cue if imported) at -20 dB every 5-10 s; share the cue list with the community farm build-site fix.
audio_needed: optional: same saw/drill CC0 cues as the community farm build

title: Mega-area ore rocks (mrock) shatter with the wooden 'crate_break' sound instead of 'rock_break'
repro: Mega area: mine an ore rock to 0 hp. region.gd ~line 811 plays sfx('crate_break','thud') (wood splinters) though audio/sfx/rock_break(_2,_3) exists and the hits use 'pick'.
fix: region.gd mrock break: Music.sfx('rock_break','crate_break').

title: Every rock in the game shatters with a WOOD crack: 'crate_break' is wooden recordings (CC0 wood_impact/crack01/04, wood_breaking_01) but is used as the rock-break sound
repro: audio/CC0_USED.json: crate_break <- 35-wooden-crackshitsdestructions/... and wood_breaking_01; rock_break <- breaking-rock + stones. Yet GameMap.break_rock (game_map.gd:998, 'the shatter'), mine ore rocks (mine.gd:989), mountain.gd:179, moon.gd:200, companion.gd:299 (pup/companion breaking rock/mrock), region.gd:811 (mega mrock), hidden_area.gd:430/439 (sun door, rock crack) all play crate_break. rock_break is only used by enemy death and the community farm. Mine crates (mine.gd:2222) and the convoy are the correct crate_break uses.
fix: Switch all rock/ore/stone breaks to Music.sfx('rock_break','crate_break'); keep crate_break for crates, barrels, carts and the convoy. Supersedes the region.gd mrock item and the crack half of the hidden-area item.

title: 'horn' is a BICYCLE horn (CC0 bicycle-horn-1.wav): a campaign commander 'takes the field' to a bike honk, and the penguin crystal sled arrives with one
repro: audio/CC0_USED.json horn <- bicycle-horn/bicycle-horn-1.wav. battle.gd:466 plays sfx('horn','alert') with the shake and boss theme when the enemy captain/commander enters ('A full boss theme, the horn...'); campaign_convoy.gd:104 honks it on arrival in both arcs (penguin crystal sled too). Comic honk at the most dramatic beat of a campaign fight.
fix: Import a real war horn / brass blast as 'war_horn' (CC0 or ACE kit j_war_horn) and use it at battle.gd:466 (gangster arc: a car-alarm-free alternative like a low brass sting or 'boss_sting'); convoy arrival: gangster 'car_horn' (real car horn), penguins 'sled_bells'. Keep 'horn' (bike) only for comic uses. Note to fixers: earlier items in this file that suggest 'horn' should use the new war_horn.
audio_needed: war horn / brass rally blast (1-2 s); real car horn (gangster convoy)

title: Mustered team members (people: crew, friends, partner) sound like machines: they fire 'laser'/'spell_lightning' and 'power off' or shatter like glass when knocked out
repro: Campaign battle with a mustered team (Battle._field_team -> HelperUnit.make_team draws a character sprite). Their striker attacks use the unit style (gangster 'drone' -> laser pistol, penguin 'crystal' -> spell_lightning) and a KO plays power_off (MachinePowerOff) or glass with the 'falls back to camp' toast.
fix: In HelperUnit, when team_id != '': attack -> gangster Player.gun_sound('six_shooter') ('shot') / penguins 'swing' or 'spell_*' by the member's role; KO -> 'hurt' + 'thud' (or the character's own hurt voice if any) instead of power_off/glass. Keep drone/crystal sounds for spawned units.

title: Attacking from the campaign board swells the area song back in for the fade before the battle music; a refused launch closes the board silently
repro: Board > Attack (or Training drill): _close_now() calls Music.play(m.area_track()) and then Campaign.launch/launch_drill go_to the battlefield, so the farm/town song crossfades in for the transition, then the battle song. If Campaign.launch returns early (no field / can_attack false) the board has already closed: nothing happens, no sound.
fix: Give _close_now(restore_music := true) and pass false from _attack/_start_drill (keep campaign_map playing into the fade); check Campaign.can_attack before closing and play sfx('nope','thud') + _flash_msg if it fails.
